label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
To: timeline:rosario.bautista
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

Happy happy happy!!! 🎉🎉 Lorna Villaruz, your PIN number came through and you are now officially a registered nurse in the UK!!! I am crying and shouting at the same time, ask Ben 😂

Do you remember Iloilo, 1996, our capping ceremony? Same hairstyle, same dream, and the same white shoes we polished every night in the dorm. You always borrowed my polish and never bought your own, and I am still waiting for it back haha. Some things never change.

Then in 2004 I left for the UK and you cried at the airport and said "susunod ako, I will follow you." Twenty years of me telling you to come, and now you are really coming!!! Liverpool, here we come 😭

So here is the plan, everybody note it: Lorna lands in Manchester on 14 January, around 1pm, from Dubai, after almost 18 years in Riyadh and Dubai. She will stay with us for the first month in our spare room (Ben already said ok, so it's official 😂), and she starts on Ward 7 at Mersey Bank Hospital on 25 January.

When she was doing her exams in Nottingham I sent her a photo of the rain so she knows what she is getting into. Lorna, I hope you still have the bravery you had in 1996. And please bring a proper coat, the Liverpool wind is no joke. Not the thin one from Divisoria!! I will take you to TK Maxx myself if I have to.

Ward 7 is very lucky to have you. You are the calmest nurse I know, and the patients love you, I have seen it with my own eyes. Welcome to the ward, welcome to Liverpool, Charing's sister from another mother is finally home 🥰

And to all my Filipino family here, please make her feel welcome!! Lorna, you are not coming to a strange place. You will have the Christmas parties, the potluck where everybody brings too much pancit, and Simbang Gabi next December with us. Come, eat, dance, and never be lonely again. Mga kabayan, say hello to Lorna!

Thank you, Lord, for answering all those prayers, and thank you to everyone who waited with her. Welcome to Liverpool, Lorna. Finally, you are here!!! ❤️

reasons: It does not explicitly tag Lorna, mention the Nottingham OSCE, or say she is the best nurse Rosario knows.
